definitions.ask: Add a 1.5 s guard after the PRE exit landing that swallows a repeated rapid press?
definitions.why: 20 of 36 mornings ended PRE in a 2 s-or-less run; the next real answer took 5 s or more

choices.label: Walk keys swallowed 1.5 s after the exit, so an extra press can't close the NEW task
Usual 350 ms settle; an extra press after that completes the landed row

definitions.ask: When POST is the only group left after PRE, should Ctrl+Enter land on POST's first row?
definitions.why: Bryan asked for the next review group; the guard covers Morning review too

choices.label: Lands on POST's first row, where ]s goes; one rule for every next group
Keeps today's `]s → POST` stop there, matching the lane rule

definitions.ask: Add the decision record decisions/ctrl-enter-leaves-pre for this course change?
definitions.requested: After I complete the final task in the PRE GTD review group, we should jump to the first task in the next review group, but I think we intentionally do not currently. Can you help me fix this?

definitions.ask: Mark decisions/answering-advances-the-walk superseded in part by the new record?
definitions.corrects: Ctrl+Enter never auto-advances across the PRE/POST checklist boundary.

strands: Answering A Walk Landing Advances The Walk
